text: Root cause found (run 37827826417 Linux job): the cascade starts at 19:17, not in SourceRepairFileFxSuite. NativeCommandJourneySuite loads the 153 MB native golden archive (30 entries, 11.5M density cells; load-native-artifacts 37 s, restored-result 40 s, readback 49 s) and times out at 301 s; NativeGoldenCommandFxSuite then throws java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space inside ArtifactResolver.document (circe parse of an archive JSON document, ArtifactResolution.scala:936). The forked studioDesktop test JVM has no -Xmx (build.sbt Test/fork with studioFxTestOptions only), so it gets 1/4 of runner RAM (~4 GB Linux 16 GB runner, ~1.75 GB macOS 7 GB runner) versus ~8 GB on a 32 GB dev machine: local gates pass, hosted fail. After the OOM every later FX suite times out (SourceChecks, QueriesNavigator, GeometryPanel beforeAll, SourceRecords, SourceRepairFile) until the 60-min cancel. Contributing product issue: ArtifactResolver.decode parses every JSON document of a manifest into circe trees simultaneously while holding all verified bytes. Plan: (1) measure peak heap of the native suites; (2) explicit fork heap + -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError so an OOM fails the run immediately; (3) decode documents one at a time to cut peak memory.
